testimonials.name: Rohith Pradeep Kongot
testimonials.role: Senior Engineer (NPD) at Alpha Design Technologies
testimonials.quote: I have attended worth sessions on FEA along with industrial examples conducted by trusted trainer Dr. Joel Daniel. His teaching methodology helped me in learning from scratch to complex industrial problems. He has sound knowledge on FEA theory, ansys workbench, apdl. Apart from training, his qualities like, helping & down to earth nature, mentoring to boost the career are really appreciable. He assisted me in learning structural design which includes linear and nonlinear, structural vibrations and rotor dynamics etc. I strongly recommend his training for fresher as well as experienced one who really wants to rule the FEA world.
